text:
Diego M.: Quick kickoff for Empirical Systems bench @Empirical. Goal: joint perf/W and steady-throughput validation on their board. Target steady band ~2k toks/s. Proposed run: Tue 08:30 PT. Who owns telemetry, kernel drop-in, and embargo handling?
Hannah L.: I can own telemetry. Plan: 1s JSONL with fields (ts, run_id, model, batch, seq_len, tokens, latency_ms, gpu_watts, pdu_watts, kernel_tag). Will post schema + example to #eng-ml by Mon EOD.
Vik S.: Kernel micro-opts delivered as drop-in modules under /opt/empirical/modules. Will include apply.sh, rollback.sh, SBOM and signed tarball. No rebuild required.
BenchBot: Reservation confirmed: empirical-lab-1 Tue 08:30-12:30 PT for `empirical_day1_bench`. Use `@BenchBot extend empirical-lab-1 1h` to add time.
Diego M.: Models/datasets: redwood-microbench-v3; models: mpt-7b-quant-v3 and llama2-13B-q4a. KV cache off, deterministic seed. Batch sizes 1,8,32. Sequence len 2048.
Hannah L.: Telemetry ingestion path: POST JSONL to telemetry-ingest topic `empirical_day1`. I'll also provide a tiny CLI so Empirical can smoke-test ingestion.
Vik S.: Perf guardrails: abort run and capture full traces if perf/W regresses >5% vs baseline tag `baseline/empirical-ref`. We'll upload traces to /artifacts/empirical/aborts.
Diego M.: Comms/legal: partner requested co-announcement; Legal suggests 48h embargo after final run. @LegalBot please confirm NDA clause.
LegalBot: Noted. Confirming NDA clause now. Default embargo 48h is reasonable; will flag if partner NDA requires different window.
Diego M.: Standardized run command we'll use to keep results comparable:
```bash
./empirical_bench --suite redwood-microbench-v3 \
  --models mpt-7b-quant-v3,llama2-13B-q4a \
  --seq 2048 --batches 1,8,32 \
  --metrics throughput,latency,perf_per_watt \
  --trace kernel:hotspots --out traces/empirical_day1
```
Hannah L.: Action items: telemetry schema + CLI (Hannah) by Mon EOD.
Vik S.: Module tarball + apply/rollback + SBOM (Vik) Tue AM.
Diego M.: I'll assemble runbook + automation and coordinate dry-run Mon 16:00 PT. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
